item.title: Attending the ICML2026 conference
item.description:
I attended the 2026 edition of International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) to present our position paper Reinforcement Learning Foundation Models Should Already Be A Thing. I had a really great time.

There was actually so many great talks and posters presentations that I felt overwhelmed, and now that it is finished I feel the need to actually write them down somewhere. I believe writing with the intent to be understood by someone else is a nice way to organize one’s thought, and so this is what I will attempt here. The points are very roughly in chronological order.
